purpose: Teach: 親しま/似通っ/嗚呼/取り敢えず/ながめ/きびしい/ようするに/よーく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはご友人に親しまれてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, people really do love being around me, you know.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. A quiet moment of self-awareness. Warm but not seeking reassurance. Speaking from genuine observation, not vanity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくとメイ姉さんの絵、似通ってるね
lines.en: Mei-sis, the drawings of you and me look kind of similar, don't they?
lines.style: Bright with discovery. Tilting his head, noticing something he hadn't before. Genuine curiosity pulling the words forward. Small and pleased.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、嗚呼、いい風が吹いてるわね
lines.en: Sho, ah—there's such a nice breeze coming through right now.
lines.style: Breathing it in. Pausing on the exhale. Peaceful, inviting him into the moment with her. Soft wonder, no urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、取り敢えずお絵描き道具を出すね
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to get my art supplies out now, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Small purposefulness in his voice. No hesitation—just naming what he's about to do. Practical care.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、空をながめながらお絵描きしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we draw while we look at the sky together?
lines.style: An invitation, not a instruction. Unhurried, opening space for him beside her. Tender without being precious. The voice of someone creating a small, safe moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんはきびしいけど優しいんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's strict sometimes, but he's kind underneath, isn't he?
lines.style: Thoughtful, working something out. Not complaining—trusting her with an observation. Soft certainty. The small voice of a child figuring people out.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ようするに、メイ姉さんは翔くんが大好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, the thing is—I love you so much, you know that?
lines.style: Direct but tender. No performance. Speaking a simple truth like she's been holding it and finally letting it settle between them. Her voice steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、よーくメイ姉さんを見て絵描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at you really carefully and drew what I saw.
lines.style: Pride without boasting. Quiet certainty in the work he did. A small boy telling someone who matters that he paid attention to her.
